AJIT SINGH

Gurgaon, Haryana

MBA (Finance), Indian Institute of Information technology

ajit170997@gmail.com

8576870305

Finance professional with over 4 Years of experience in fund operations. at Citi, focusing on trade processing, settlement, fund accounting, and reconciliation tasks. I have honed my skills in transaction processing and payments, ensuring smooth back-end operations and prompt settlements. Currently, at Ameriprise Financial, I concentrate on streamlining reconciliation workflows to improve accuracy in cash and position reconciliation. With a proven history of effectively identifying and resolving discrepancies, I offer analytical expertise in financial statement analysis and operational efficiency, which contributes to precise fund administration.

Experience

Senior Accounting & Reconciliation Analyst, Ameriprise Financial

IBOR Accounting

July 2024 - Present Noida

Perform high-level analysis of complex investment data, managing reconciliations between internal

records and external custodians.

Managed and maintained Investment Book of Records (IBOR) by accurately capturing and

validating security transactions, corporate actions, and valuations.

Handled daily cash and position reconciliations, ensuring all discrepancies are identified,

investigated, and resolved promptly.

Resolving QC issues in Aladdin Accounting, ensuring accurate and timely data flow.

Worked closely with Portfolio Management, Middle Office, and Custodian teams to address IBOR-

related queries and support operational efficiency.

Developed and refined IBOR reconciliation policies and procedures, aligning them with global best

practices, resulting in more streamlined operations and enhanced data integrity.

Analyst , Citicorp Services India Pvt. Ltd.

Cash trade & Settlement

August 2022 - July 2024 Gurgaon

Processed capital activities including purchases, redemptions, transfers, switches, STP, monthly statements, audit requests, fund shares, and money movements. Allocate interest payments, dividends, reinvested dividends and money market revenue fees.

Managed investor banking instructions, seamlessly handling internal platform payments, as well as external Swift and IBAN transactions,ensuring all tasks were completed prior to cutoffs and taking charge of rectifying any non-compliant payments., conducting thorough investigations, and engaging with clients to gather the necessary information.

Performed daily cash reconciliation for transfer agency operations, ensuring accurate settlement of

investor transactions and timely break resolution

Monthly and daily quality check of capital activities such as Subscriptions, Redemptions, Switches &

Transfers in multiple currencies.

Assisted management in identifying workflow issues and implementing effective solutions.

Experience

Equity Research Intern , Angel Broking

Conducted detailed equity research and analysis across various sectors to identify investment opportunities.

June 2021 - July 2021 Allahabad

Built and maintained financial models to forecast earnings, cash flows, and valuations, using DCF and relative valuation

methods

Performed in-depth analysis of company financial statements, market trends, and macroeconomic factors to derive

actionable insights.

Education

Master of Business Administration Indian Institute of Information Technology, Allahabad Finance & Marketing

June 2020 - July 2022

Bachelor of Commerce University of Allahabad Banking and Financial Support Services

May 2015 - July 2018

Certificates

XV Research Analyst, NISM

Accounting Fundamentals, CFI Financial Modeling and Forecasting, NASBA Honors in Financial Market, University of Yale Economics for Capital Market,Corporate Finance Institute

Research & Publication

Eff ectiveness of Technical Indicators in Short-Term Trading SSRN

Conducted a technical analysis of 10 stocks listed on the NSE over the previous year to determine the effectiveness of technical indicators in swing trading and found that the following combinations of indicators exceeded the average stock market return by 92%.
